## Boundary decisions (owned — ADR-0294)

- `LeaderboardDefinition` name history: the definition's canonical JSON is
  registered as a registry `leaderboard_definition` record (**new opaque
  `RegistryRecord` arm — schema owned by `hh-results`, stored verbatim, CC7
  the same layering as `Participant`/`Adapter`/`EnvironmentRecord`**) and the
  name binds through `registry.publish` under ADR-0153 `NamespaceRecord`
  authority (OQ-372). Registry `RecordKind` gains one arm — a `registry/1`
  dialect addition.
- `subscribe` is a derived **journal** over the existing ledger subscription
  stream (`hh-ledger` notify-after-durable): the store emits
  `RowHeadChanged | AnnotationChanged | SnapshotPublished` rows re-projected
  from durable events — never before durability, ordering preserved.
- `export_rows` artifact lives in LabDocs as `export_artifact` docs;
  `ledger_native_rows` = the row set verbatim (lossless); foreign targets
  carry a `LoweringLossReport` enumerating every `no_slot` field.
- Retention pins: `publish` records `pinned_addresses[]` on the snapshot doc;
  the store's `pin_set()` exposes them so `gc`/redaction seams refuse
  `Pinned` (CF-347).
- A9 `indistinguishable_sets` computed by paired-Δ interval overlap
  (ADR-0158 D6 / OQ-369) — task-resampled rank intervals via the shared
  `ResamplePlan`.
